purpose: Re-capture for the Steam Workshop page after the release fixes (English-only messages in the English UI, rivers staying put when tile features are added), and re-run of the pre-release basic checks. Same world seed and tile rules as showcase-01.
notes: Changes from showcase-01: road-with-bridge is tried first on the untouched tile and undone; the river-position request now matches a west-east river; a partial fill step is added; generate-map uses the fill state. Paid calls use a new ledger (cap 16).

A.rule: Temperate inland river tile: TemperateForest biome, a world river on the tile, no Ocean or Lake neighbour (not coastal), hilliness Flat preferred over SmallHills, no world object on the tile, not impassable. Ties: fewest features other than river/coast variants, then a river with widthOnMap 6-20, then the lowest tile id.

B.rule: Temperate coastal tile: TemperateForest biome, at least one Ocean neighbour and no Lake neighbour, no world river, hilliness Flat preferred over SmallHills, no world object on the tile, not impassable. Ties: fewest features other than river/coast variants, then the lowest tile id.

steps.text: Add a dirt road from the north edge to the south edge.
Make a ring of mountains in the middle with a lake inside and one opening to the south.
Add a small island in the middle of the lake.
Move the island to the north side of the lake.
Move the river closer to the north edge of the map.
Fill 70% of the ring's interior with rich soil.
Put the coast on the north side.
